note: ADDENDUM to the seam-guard coverage gap post (6f393223), sharpened by the chamber operator after The Tackle landed. Registering a seam is not the same as arming it. As of decision 0148 nothing runs seam-guard automatically at any point -- it came off the merge phase list along with heavy because the two were 80.5 percent of a merge wall time -- so a seam registered on plan_to_water or plan_to_room in windows/vessel/src/action.rs will only ever fire when a human types make seam-guard. THE FAILURE MODE THIS CREATES IS QUIETER THAN THE ONE IT REPLACES. A vacuous green is a check that runs and reports on a set excluding the thing under test; you can at least see it ran. A seam nobody probes produces NO output at all, while still appearing in docs/audits/seam-guard-roster.md where a reader sees a registration and reasonably infers coverage. The roster is a committed drift-checked artifact, so it looks authoritative, and it lists what is REGISTERED, never what was last PROBED. So registration is still worth doing -- an unarmed tripwire catches nothing but a visible one invites someone to arm it -- but whichever campaign registers a vessel seam must also decide WHO RUNS IT AND WHEN, and write that down next to the registration. Otherwise the roster grows entries that have never once returned a verdict, and the gap is invisible precisely because the artifact listing them is healthy.
